sources.title: vidIQ Pricing 2026: Every Plan and Cost Compared
vidIQ AI Pricing 2026: Free, Boost & Max Plans

freePlan.limits: 150 AI credits per month; core YouTube analytics via browser extension

keyLimits.en: 150 AI credits per month, basic browser-extension analytics only.
Only tier that can be paid monthly; annual billing drops the effective price to about $199/year.
Annual billing only (about $468/year); 6,000 AI credits/month, up to 3x more AI Coach conversations, up to 11 hours of short-form clip generation.

cautions.en: Max and the Coaching add-on are annual-only; only Boost offers a monthly billing option.
cautions.fr: Max et le module Coaching sont facturés uniquement à l'année ; seul Boost propose un paiement mensuel.

capabilities.en: YouTube keyword and topic research to find video ideas with search demand.
AI-generated titles, descriptions, tags and thumbnail suggestions for a channel's videos.
Competitor and channel analytics beyond YouTube Studio's native data.
AI Coach and short-form clip generation from long-form video on higher tiers.

limitations.en: Full analytics and AI features require the Chrome/browser extension alongside the web app.
Free plan is capped at 150 AI credits per month, well below what active channel management needs.
Higher-value tiers (Max, Coaching) lock users into annual billing with no monthly option.

reason.en: Direct competitor: same category of YouTube SEO and analytics browser extension.

missingAlternatives.name: TubeBuddy
missingAlternatives.reason: Main direct competitor; appears in currentAlternatives as tubebuddy, worth confirming catalogue slug.

unknowns: vidiq.com returned HTTP 429 (bot protection) on repeated direct fetch attempts during this session; pricing and feature facts above are sourced from independent 2026 pricing round-ups (tier 2), not the official pricing page directly.
